acceptance.given: A package supplies an FAQ entry without a declared stable error ID or decision-branch path.

oracle.expected: The FAQ reachability validator reports a validation failure identifying the orphan FAQ entry.
forbidden: An orphan FAQ entry passes validation.
oracle.observable: Validator failure status and diagnostic identifying the orphan FAQ entry during FAQ reachability validation.

acceptance.then: The orphan FAQ entry is rejected.
acceptance.when: Run FAQ reachability validation against the supplied package.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select the validator test covering an FAQ entry lacking both stable error ID and decision-branch reachability; observe the validator failure.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Reject supplied FAQ entries that have no declared stable error ID or decision-branch path.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Validation-only behavior; no persisted state or schema changes.

slice_hint.state_transition: FAQ package state transitions from supplied-orphan to rejected with a diagnostic.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The targeted validator test produces a validation failure for the orphan FAQ case.

acceptance.given: A package supplies one or more FAQ entries, each declaring or implying a local target.

oracle.expected: FAQ local-target validation resolves every supplied target successfully and reports no unresolved-target diagnostic.
forbidden: A supplied FAQ entry points to a dead or unresolved local target.
oracle.observable: Per-entry local-target resolution results showing successful resolution for every supplied FAQ entry.

acceptance.then: All supplied FAQ local targets resolve successfully.
acceptance.when: Run FAQ local-target validation and inspect its per-entry resolution results.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select the validator test that supplies FAQ entries with local targets and fail if any target remains unresolved or lacks a resolution result.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Require every supplied FAQ local target to resolve during validation.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Validation-only behavior; no persisted state or schema changes.

slice_hint.state_transition: Each supplied FAQ target transitions from unresolved candidate to resolved target evidence.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The targeted validator test succeeds only when all supplied FAQ targets resolve.
